name: mindustry-docker-dashboard
description: Development tooling (formatting and linting) for the dashboard frontend. Not used at runtime.

scripts.lint: eslint dashboard/static && stylelint "dashboard/static/**/*.css" && prettier --check "dashboard/static/**/*.{js,css,html}" && ruff check dashboard tools && ruff format --check dashboard tools
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix dashboard/static && stylelint --fix "dashboard/static/**/*.css" && ruff check --fix dashboard tools
